messages:
ada.w: Quick internal heads-up: we'll be provisioning Dedicated 'Stratus-90' pools in asia-southeast1 (singapore) as a reserved-preview on 2026-06-15 02:00 UTC. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/stratus-singapore
ken.ops: Reserved-preview only for the first 72h. Existing Dedicated customers can request migration during the window; self-serve reservations will open after stabilization.
mira.sales: Sales note: please do not promise self-serve reservations until we flip the flag (target 2026-06-18). We'll post official quota guidance shortly.
ops-bot: @channel Provisioning window: 2026-06-15 02:00-04:00 UTC. CA rebalancing expected in asia-southeast1. No planned customer downtime.
nada: (typo)
sre-oncall: Ops summary: Stratus-90 = ~90 TF infer-class, 96GB HBM, tuned kernels for short-to-medium context with very low tail latency. Benchmarks show ~1.2x token throughput vs our A100 baseline at 1k seq.
ken.ops: Policy and limits: default per-tenant replica cap = 3 during preview. Cross-zone burst borrowing will be disabled for 48h to maintain isolation. If customers need >3 replicas, submit infra-ops with expected QPS + model profile.
devex: Will the Console include migration tuning guidance?
ada2: (accident)
ada3: (sorry ignore)
ada4: (still)
ada5: (ignore repeat)
devex: Yes 1Console will surface a "Stratus quick-tune" checklist with recommended batching, KV cache hints, and an example autoscale snippet. We'll add a one-click quickstart.
mira.sales: Billing question: is there a price delta for preview reservations?
ada6: (oops)
ada7: (apologies)
ada8: (stop)
mira.sales: (repost) Billing question: is there a price delta for preview reservations?
ada9: (ignore)
ken.ops: Billing: per-token pricing remains unchanged but there will be a 9% "stratus_preview" uplift applied to reserved commitments during the preview period to offset ramp costs. Removed at GA.
sre-oncall: Oncall will monitor tail-latency, KV-cache hit-rate, and eviction events. If tail latency or 5xxs spike, tag @sre-oncall and open an incident channel.
prod-marketing: We'll draft the customer bulletin for review tomorrow 10:00 SGT and link migration docs in #eng-runtime. Please review promptly.
ada10: (really sorry)
ada.w: Ignore the earlier noise, folks. Thanks for the ack. Reminder: do not promise open-reservations until we lift caps. If ops needs help with customer coordination ping @prod-marketing. :rocket:
